what: Hovering a pill text button fills the plate with the accent color in .45s circ-out, pushes the label 1.25em toward the icon, and slides the right icon out to the right while the same icon hiding off the left slides in and settles. All three use a .6s bounce curve (overshooting to 1.03 before settling). With look: start it is a 「← Back」 button with the icon in front, so the direction is reversed. With look: expand only the round icon cell at the end shows until the pointer arrives, then it unfolds into a pill (clip-path .6s bounce). When the part is attached to a card, it unfolds wherever the pointer lands on the card.
ease: Bounce linear() curve (original --ease-bounce) · fill uses cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1)

options.look: start (before the icon — the label is pushed the other way and the back icon slides in) · expand (round box → pill unfolds)
options.--fx-bg · --fx-ink · --fx-bg-on · --fx-i: Normal and interaction panel and text colors (css), default --kf-ink and --kf-bg → --kf-accent and --kf-on-accent
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-color-dur ·: Position-swap duration and curve, fill duration and curve (css)
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Panel (child) — lead, label, tail in order inside it
options.[data-fx-part=lead] · [data-fx-part=tail: Front and back icons (same graphic, two copies)

use: ↗Visit the site↗
note: Attach the part to a card and place the plate at the card corner (look: expand) and it becomes an ‹Expand› button that unfolds on card hover — the plate position is up to the user

from.where: shared.css .s-cbtn (original .c-button -secondary·-light × -translate·-expand) — project.html ”See the website”, notfound.html ”Back to works” (look: start), project.html info card ”Expand” (look: expand, card hover · font size input field)
